change_summary: Preserve exact continuation subjects before broad discovery and require durable owner evidence when a user asks to reconcile a reusable practice.

canonical_skill.note: The canonical Skill makes exact continuation handles an ordering authority and distinguishes durable method reconciliation from a chat-only comparison.

server_contract.note: Contract 2026-09-15.8 exposes the same continuation and durable-reconciliation semantics across MCP hosts while preserving Agent-owned planning and typed Runtime receipts.

package_manifests.note: Skill and Plugin manifests advance together to 1.7.48 without changing transport, trust, consent, or compatibility-family boundaries.

workspace_cli.note: Workspace/Admin CLI remain at 0.1.0-beta.32; registry-backed update checks return an exact install command plus post-install verification, and Workspace capabilities expose server-owned limits.

help_center.note: Public guidance explains continuation subject authority and the evidence needed to complete reusable-method reconciliation.

package_setup.note: Setup and SessionStart keep exact continuation subjects ahead of broad search and require durable method-owner closure without changing write consent.

harness_and_mainline.note: The owner history records the 30-turn semantic audit, preserves Prompt-owned planning, and adds deterministic lossless line movement as execution capability rather than semantic fallback.

external_marketplaces.note: First-party 1.7.48 publication and hashes can be verified here; Claude directory acceptance and fresh secondary-host behavior remain external receipts.

release_evidence.note: Focused tests cover continuation precedence, durable method reconciliation, lossless line movement, adapter convergence, package export, and localized Help; fresh semantic reruns are the live behavior gate.
